segments.he: כִּי אִיצְטְרִיךְ לֵיהּ כְּגוֹן דְּהֵפֵר אֶחָד מֵהֶן וְקִיֵּים אֶחָד, וְחָזַר הַמְקַיֵּים וְנִשְׁאַל עַל הֲקָמָתוֹ. מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא: מַאי דְּאוֹקִי הָא עַקְרֵיהּ, קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן דִּמְפִירִין שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּבַת אַחַת.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: «It was necessary for» the mishna to mention this «in» a case «where one of them nullified» the vow «and» the other «one ratified» it, «and the one who ratified» the woman’s vow «retracted and requested» dissolution «of his ratification» from a halakhic authority, who dissolved it. «Lest you say: That which he ratified» is what «he uprooted,» by asking the halakhic authority to dissolve his ratification, and therefore the vow is no more, the mishna «teaches us that they both must nullify» it «together.»

moves.summary: needed where one ratified then had the ratification dissolved: both must nullify together

positions.claim: both must nullify together; an annulled ratification plus the other's earlier nullification does not suffice
